records.text: Owens said Charlie Kirk and Michael McCoy arrived in one Yukon Denali driven by a security person known only as Christopher.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Now, to the right of them, we have back-to-back Yukon Denalis. You, of course, know that one of the front is going to be the one that Charlie Kirk shows up in and that Charlie Kirk is going to depart in after he is hit with an explosive. ... And we know that he shows up with Mikey McCoy (Michael McCoy) in that vehicle. And we also know that the person driving it, we only have a first name for this guy. ... But his name is Christopher (security driver; surname unverified), okay? We're going to talk more about this Chris (Christopher; security driver; surname unverified) guy in a second.

records.text: Owens said Justin Davis, who arrived driving a different vehicle, drove Christopher’s vehicle to the hospital with Charlie Kirk after the shooting.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Brian Harpole is in that vehicle. And Justin Davis is a very relevant person for you to know because he's going to eventually be the driver that takes Charlie (Charlie Kirk) to the hospital. ... If suddenly Justin Davis, who is driving the car on the left-hand side, now has to drive Christopher (security driver; surname unverified)'s vehicle to the hospital.

records.text: Owens interpreted footage as showing Christopher, the security driver whose surname is unverified, and Nate Walker upstairs near the Sorensen building minutes before Kirk was struck, away from Kirk’s vehicle.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Yet Christopher (security driver; surname unverified), for some odd reason, Minutes before Charlie (Charlie Kirk) gets hit, he decides to go upstairs with Nate Walker, and he is upstairs when the shot goes off. So Chris (Christopher; security driver; surname unverified), the security person who has the keys, who locks the car, is upstairs when the explosive goes off. ... We're now we're putting a little white thing on that. That's Chris (Christopher; security driver; surname unverified) in the front. And you're going to see behind him, that's Nate. ... So he's upstairs and Nate is upstairs when the explosive goes off. Again, this is minutes before the explosive goes off. What were they doing? Where were they? ... Why were they headed toward the Sorensen building? At this moment, nobody knows, okay? But it's relevant. What could there be to do toward the Sorensen building on a campus that you've never been to when Charlie (Charlie Kirk) specifically expressed?

records.text: Owens said she thought the bag left behind belonged to Christopher, explicitly stating she was not 100 percent certain and was reasoning by elimination.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I think that that's Chris (Christopher; security driver; surname unverified)'s bag. ... I think, again, I will say not 100% certain that it's his bag, but given the fact that Mikey McCoy (Michael McCoy) showed up with a bag and has it on his back and just process of elimination here, I think that's going to be the security person's bag.
